Terms of use

Updated 20 November 2026

These terms govern use of Mob’s website, desktop and Android apps, and browser extension. Mob is maintained by Lakshya. The Privacy Policy explains how the service handles account and activity data.

Accounts and acceptable use

Keep your login credentials secure and use an account you are authorized to access. Do not impersonate others, submit abusive material, or interfere with the service or another person’s account. You can browse your local workspace as a guest and sign in to use supported sync features.

Your workspace and public profile

You retain rights in your tasks and settings. Mob processes that data to provide the features you enable. Sharing a focus score is optional. When enabled, your username, score, position and eligible profile photo are visible to signed-in users. You can turn sharing off in Social or delete your account in Profile.

Availability and device permissions

Mob is a productivity tool. Reminders, sync, usage reporting and blocking depend on your device settings, permissions and connectivity. These features may be delayed or interrupted, so use a separate reminder for a deadline you cannot miss. These terms do not limit rights you have under applicable law.

Third-party services and media

Features such as Google sign-in and Spotify playback are subject to those providers’ terms. Recordings, code and other assets distributed under separate licenses retain those licenses. See Credits and licenses.

Changes and contact

The date above identifies the current version of these terms. Questions can be raised in the Mob issue tracker. Use it to request a private contact method for account matters and keep personal information out of public issues.
